other_conditions: Applicant must be registered Below Poverty Line (BPL) in a rural area
Applicant must not own any plot or house
Applicant must not have taken benefit of any other housing scheme
Applicant may own a maximum of half a hectare of irrigated land or a maximum of one hectare of unrelated land
If husband and wife live together in the same village for the last five years, either can apply even if a plot or house is in the name of the spouse
Applicant must be a native of the village and hold the village BPL card
Applicant must obtain a certificate from the village Sarpanch confirming no prior benefit under the scheme
Applicant must provide a certificate that there is no house in the name of the applicant or spouse in the native place
Benefit is available only once per villager
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance/subsidy for economically weaker and low‑income groups to construct their own pucca houses, improving living standards.
documents_required: Certificate from the Sarpanch stating no prior benefit under Sardar Patel Awas Yojana
Certificate confirming no house exists in the name of the applicant or spouse
